answer: Because the voyage index resolves every citation against the ivory checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the orchard audit keeps the resolved set. An answer must cite at least 3 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. A farm of 2698 identities would post 3774 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
